name: Jovita Ulinskiene
reason: Too thin: her own site jovitaflowsoul.com (Lincolnshire, United Kingdom; no robots.txt, so open to us) is a single page whose only practice offering is a remote Quantum-Touch session (no own URL beyond the home page); the rest is two paid songs on Payhip, a 'Meditations' tile with no meditations, and poetry books with no ISBNs. Its Quantum-Touch section also lists pain, inflammation, injury recovery and anxiety as benefits, which would have to be left out. For the owner: she trained with Karina Grant (already listed); revisit if the site grows.
